- Ashgrove’s 2025 household water use was 4,390 megalitres, and its 2025 population was 58,760 residents. [NR-10]
- One megalitre is 1,000,000 litres. [NR-15]
- 2025 has 365 days.

Calculations:
- Tarnvale: \(5,207 \times 1,000,000 \div 71,388 \div 365 = 199.747\) litres per resident per day.
